name: Transmogrifier Backend Protocol and Factory
description: Backend protocol and factory for Level 3 LLM-based translation. Defines the Backend protocol interface for LLM completion and provides a factory function to instantiate backend implementations (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) based on environment variables or explicit parameters.

types.name: Backend
types.description: Protocol class defining the interface for LLM backend implementations. Any conforming backend must implement the complete() method.

functions.name: create_backend
functions.description: Factory function that creates a backend instance from environment variables or explicit arguments. Reads TRANSMOG_BACKEND env var (defaults to 'anthropic') and dynamically imports the corresponding backend implementation.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Backend type to instantiate ('anthropic', 'openai', or 'gemini'). If None, reads from TRANSMOG_BACKEND env var.

inputs.name: kwargs
inputs.description: Additional keyword arguments passed to the backend constructor.

error_cases.name: unknown_backend
error_cases.condition: backend parameter (or TRANSMOG_BACKEND env var) is not one of 'anthropic', 'openai', or 'gemini'

postconditions: Returns a Backend instance that implements the complete() method
The returned backend is one of: AnthropicBackend, OpenAIBackend, or GeminiBackend
side_effects: Dynamically imports backend modules based on selection

structured_side_effects.description: Reads environment variable to determine backend

functions.name: complete
functions.description: Protocol method for LLM completion. Takes a system prompt, message list, and max token count, returns a string completion. This is a protocol method signature, not a concrete implementation.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: List of message dictionaries for the conversation history

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

postconditions: Returns a string completion from the LLM

invariants: Default backend is 'anthropic' when TRANSMOG_BACKEND is not set
Only three backend types are supported: 'anthropic', 'openai', 'gemini'
All backends must implement the Backend protocol (complete method)

data_access.rationale: Reads TRANSMOG_BACKEND environment variable to determine which backend to instantiate

side_effects.rationale: Required to select backend implementation when not explicitly specified
